changelog:
Initial release of huawei-cloud-msot-msopprof-operator-profiler.

- Enables collection of operator-level performance data on Ascend NPU using msopprof.
- Supports both device and simulator profiling modes; generates detailed performance analysis reports.
- Integrates a searchable knowledge base with migration case studies and operator optimization recipes.
- Provides architecture overview, workflow steps, and core usage commands for profiling and report generation.
- Includes example migration success story (YOLOv8) and optimization best practices for common operators.
summary: Collect operator-level performance data on Ascend NPU using msopprof tool. Supports both device mode and simulator mode, generates performance analysis reports. Use this skill when the user wants to: (1) profile operator performance on Ascend NPU, (2) collect performance data for analysis, (3) identify performance bottlenecks through operator execution characteristics. Trigger: user mentions "msopprof", "profiler", "performance profiling", "operator profiling", "Ascend", "NPU", "profile data", "性能采集", "算子性能", "性能剖析", "算子耗时采集"
